items.title: Marvin Harrison: Will make Texans debut Sunday
items.text:
Texans head coach DeMeco Ryans confirmed Wednesday that Harrison will make his team debut Sunday versus the Jaguars, Jonathan M. Alexander of the Houston Chronicle reports.

items.title: Ladd McConkey: Set to practice Wednesday
items.text:
Chargers head coach Jim Harbaugh said McConkey (foot) will practice Wednesday, Alex Insdorf of BoltBeat.com reports.

items.title: DeVonta Smith: Working on side Wednesday
items.text:
Smith (hamstring) was working on the JUGS machine during Wednesday's practice, Olivia Reiner of The Philadelphia Inquirer reports.

items.title: Ashton Jeanty: Improving, won't be rested due to injury
items.text:
Head coach Klint Kubiak said Wednesday that Jeanty is "starting to feel a lot better physically," and the Raiders have had no discussions of resting him, Sam Warren of The Athletic reports. "I'm excited about giving him even more reps in practice and more full-speed reps," Kubiak said.

items.title: Saquon Barkley: Not seen Wednesday
items.text:
Barkley (hamstring) wasn't spotted at the portion of Wednesday's practice open to the media, Jimmy Kempski of PhillyVoice.com reports.
